name: tag-picker
title: Tag picker
description: Pick tags from a pool, and each one flies into the box and back out when removed.

props.name: options
props.description: Every tag that can be picked.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled ids of the picked tags, in the order they were picked.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Ids picked at the start when the picker is not controlled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new list of picked ids each time a tag is added or removed.

props.name: label
props.description: Heading above the picker, also the name of the group.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown in the empty box before anything is picked.

props.name: labels
props.description: Visible text and screen reader text; defaults to English. `added` and `removed` follow the tag name in the live announcement.

a11y.text: Every tag in the pool and every remove button is a native button, so Tab, Enter and Space pick and remove. When a tag moves, focus follows it: picking a tag focuses its remove button in the box, and removing one focuses the tag in the pool.

The picker is a group labelled by label (default Tags). The picked tags are a list labelled Picked and the pool a list labelled Available. Each remove button is named Remove <tag label>, and its icon is aria-hidden. The empty box shows placeholder text. A persistent status region says <tag> added or <tag> removed. All of these words come from labels.
The picker is wrapped in MotionConfig with reducedMotion set to user, so Motion follows the system setting for the flight between the lists. The colour transitions are off under reduced motion.
